details: Binance has reportedly recovered or covered approximately 95% of the $6.3 billion in assets stolen in a major hack on October 29. The exchange has begun to restore withdrawals in phases. However, investors have collectively pulled $3.6 billion in funds from the platform, resulting in a net outflow and signaling lingering security concerns and a dip in investor confidence across the broader crypto market.
title: Binance Recovers Stolen Funds, But Billions in Outflows Persist After Hack

details: Bitcoin is struggling to maintain its position, trading below $77,000 and defending the critical $76,000 support level, which represents the average cost basis for recent buyers. The market is facing pressure from significant institutional fund withdrawals from spot Bitcoin ETFs, with over $1 billion in outflows in late October and early November. This, combined with the Binance hack and broader macroeconomic uncertainties, has triggered liquidations of leveraged long positions.
title: Bitcoin Defends $76K Amid Market Sell-Off and ETF Outflows

details: BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) has seen substantial outflows, with approximately $1.3 billion worth of Ethereum (580,145 ETH) being offloaded within the last month. This occurred as ETH prices dropped about 16% over the same period. Spot Ethereum ETFs have experienced 11 consecutive days of outflows, losing $432 million in the final week of October, bringing their total assets down to $13.2 billion.
title: BlackRock's Ethereum ETF Records $1.3 Billion in Monthly Outflows

details: The Ethereum Devcon 2026 conference is underway in Mumbai from November 3-6. The event is centered on the technical delivery and real-world implementation of Ethereum upgrades. Key themes include transitioning research into production, addressing system failures, and fostering coordination among open-source developer groups, gathering the global Ethereum developer community.
title: Ethereum Devcon 2026 Kicks Off in Mumbai, Focuses on Implementation

details: The upcoming U.S. midterm elections on November 3rd are contributing to market uncertainty. Historically, Bitcoin has shown significant price movements around midterm elections, with some analysts suggesting potential further downside before a market bottom in late 2026 or early 2027 based on past patterns. The election results could influence crypto regulation, fiscal policy, and interest rate expectations, leading to short-term market volatility.
title: US Midterm Elections on November 3 Raise Crypto Market Volatility Concerns

details: Despite recent market volatility and sell-offs, MicroStrategy (MSTR) has announced another strategic acquisition of Bitcoin. The company purchased 811 BTC for approximately $65.5 million at an average price of $80,846 per coin. This latest move increases MicroStrategy's total holdings to 849,327 BTC, reinforcing its long-term conviction in the cryptocurrency.
title: MicroStrategy Continues Bitcoin Accumulation Amidst Market Downturn

details: Machine learning prediction models are offering a divided forecast for Bitcoin's price movement through November 2026. While DeepSeek Chat, an AI model, projects a potential recovery to around $80,250, other models like Gemini 3.5 Flash and ChatGPT-5.7 Luna predict further declines, with price targets ranging from $74,500 to $75,200. This mixed sentiment from AI tools reflects the current uncertainty surrounding Bitcoin's short-term trajectory.
title: AI Models Present Mixed Bitcoin Price Outlook for November
